text:
mara_cs: quick note — pilot cohort in EU needs localized onboards + explicit consent micro-survey before feature enablement. we need translations, scheduling, and consent telemetry tied to account metadata.

devon_cs: i can build consent endpoint and storage. will it be account-level or user-level? need token flow for auto-attach.

sam_se: will own demo invites and runbook. prefer 30m sessions. also request role-based invite links.

iren_loc: i can translate quickstart and 3 survey strings into de/fr/es. timeline: deliver by sunday EOD if final english copy by tomorrow EOD.

legal-bot: legal note — DE/FR require explicit checkbox with purpose + retention (12 months). ES can use informational banner.

devon_cs: endpoint shape: user_id, account_id, ts, consent_version, locale, flags. will publish /cs/consent/v1/collect on staging. need SSO tokens from support.

mara_cs: sending the account list now: kepler(DE,de,09:30 CET), blueharbor(FR,fr,14:00 CET), solace(ES,es,10:30 CET), mosaic(DE,de,15:00 CET), opal(FR,fr,11:00 CET).

sam_se: i'll block demo slots monday morning CET and share calendar links + short runbook.

devon_cs: will run smoke at 1898765380 and post results. header X-Redwood-Test:pilot-eu for test calls.

mara_cs: plan: localized quickstart + consent live by Mon 12:00 CET, outreach starts after. thanks! :thumbsup:
